name: Nyan Kare
source:
You weren’t sure about where you should work. That’s when you happen across a job ad for a cat café. You set foot inside the cat café to find hot guys with cat ears?! A slightly heartrending and slightly sweet love story with the kitty cats is about to begin!

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.nekokaigai]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你还不确定该找什么工作。就在这时，你偶然看到了一则猫咖招聘广告。你走进猫咖，却发现里面竟有戴着猫耳的帅哥！？
一段略带心酸、又有些甜蜜的猫咪恋爱故事即将开始！

（来源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.nekokaigai]Google Play[/url]）
